question: Who won the title of the 34th National Snooker championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pankaj Advani**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pankaj Arjan Advani** had won the** 34th National Snooker Championship,**he is a 23-time world champion of the** International Billiards and Snooker Federation.**
 
• Pankaj has also received several government accolades from India, including the** Padma Bhushan in 2018.**
 
• Despite being only 34 years old at the time of writing, India's Pankaj Advani has won **15 World Championship Billiards championship.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b16e9233d22e25a7b81ca2d6142ce237c575c2eca4b88eb6df7b5b43e60d7d1d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ishpreet singh **won the **Men's senior snooker title at the Sage Nationals India 2021**, he is a professional snooker player ending up his place at Asian Championship.
 
• **Sourav Kothari **is an Indian English billiards player. In 2018, he was crowned global champion.
 
• **Laxman Rawat **clinched the title in the Ajay Rastogi Memorial-All India Open Snooker Championship 2020.
